verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says its cloud coding sessions, where Linear Agent writes code, now support signed commits once the user adds an SSH or GPG key in Settings. That directly covers the core of the story. However, the evidence is a single changelog line with no detail on enforcement. missing for 10: evidence that signing can be required or enforced rather than just enabled, in-depth documentation of the signing setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
